ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The diagram is a food web, with multiple organism names connected by arrows. In the lower right there is a green label “Arctic Hares.” Near it, the yellow label “Lichens” on the bottom right has an arrow pointing upward to “Arctic Hares,” indicating that lichens are a food source for Arctic hares. Then reason: The question asks, if the number of Arctic Hares increases, which organism is most likely to decrease. In a food web, when the number of consumers increases, the food it eats will decrease because it is preyed on or consumed more. Since the arrow shows that Lichens are consumed by Arctic Hares, the organism most likely to decrease when Arctic Hares increase is Lichens.
